sonnet.problem: Story card 12 already tells the baker that the flock bore speckled and streaked offspring. That sets up the answer to this question and rules out the wrong answers (pure white, solid black) before the baker has to reason anything out. The question mostly re-asks a fact the baker has just been given.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
